purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian financial/sales reporting system - AcompTTC (TTC tracking/accompaniment) Dispersão (Dispersion) report for sales structure analysis
purpose.summary: This program generates a web-based report screen (AcompTTC - Dispersão) for analyzing sales dispersion across a sales structure hierarchy. It renders an HTML form with filters for sales team structure, management products, date range, dispersion variation, ordering options, and view type (analytic/synthetic), then injects JavaScript for interactivity. It is part of a CGI/web framework using GnuCOBOL with an HTML preprocessor.

notable_features: EXEC HTML preprocessor blocks (htmlpp) for embedded HTML generation
OO COBOL INVOKE statement and REPOSITORY CLASS declarations
$set compiler directives for free format and preprocessor
CGI/web framework with external-form linkage section
Multiple COPY statements for framework copybooks (PCW900, PCW0007, PCWY90001, PCW902, PCW990, PCPY8000, PCP9000)
Portuguese-language comments and HTML content indicating Brazilian origin
verdict.notes: The program uses a Brazilian GnuCOBOL web framework with an HTML preprocessor (htmlpp). EXEC HTML blocks are not standard COBOL but a preprocessor extension. The program_type is mapped to online-cics as the closest enum for an interactive web/CGI program. OPC comments in identification division suggest an operational process catalog numbering system. The file uses free source format despite being archived as .cbl.
